## Consistency checklist

- [ ] Specification, schemas, policy code, CLI behavior, docs, tests, hooks, adapters, and CI remain aligned where affected.
- [ ] I added a passing and failing example for normative behavior changes.
- [ ] Mutating behavior validates the prospective state before writing.
- [ ] I disclosed material AI or automated-tool assistance.
- [ ] I did not claim mathematical correctness, external review, or project conformance from CI alone.
- [ ] I documented known limitations and unresolved concerns.
